en.i1t: Four sessions, 22,908 kg on two lifting days
en.i1: Four sessions, 4h 44m, 22,908 kg, 2,639 active kcal — against five sessions and 39,888 kg the week before. Saturday’s front squat day is the heaviest piece: 81 minutes, 21 sets, 240 reps, 11,520 kg, avg HR 111, max 158, 604 active kcal. Tuesday’s deadlift day ran 76 minutes, 18 sets, 246 reps, 11,388 kg, avg HR 123, max 155, 712 active kcal. The two pool swims — 2,250 m Friday, 2,200 m Monday — add 1,323 kcal across 127 minutes.
en.i2: Saturday’s front squat held 80 kg and reached 10 reps on the top set, two more than the 8 taken at the same load on Aug 23 and Aug 29. Session tonnage went 9,875 kg to 11,520 kg, up 16.7% across 21 sets and 240 reps. Avg HR 111 was the lowest of the four sessions on this board and max 158 the highest — a heavy top end on an otherwise cheap session.
en.i3t: Swim Sep 7: 2,200 m at 2:18 per 100 m
en.i3: Monday’s pool swim covered 2,200 m in 64 minutes as 10×100 + 10×50, averaging 2:18 per 100 m — two seconds off the 2:16 held on Aug 31 over the identical set, and level with the 2:18 of Aug 26. Avg HR 121, max 148, 661 active kcal, 27 strokes per minute over 88 lengths. Friday’s N4×4 set covered 2,250 m at 2:26, eight seconds per 100 m slower on a higher avg HR of 125. Zagreb air ran 16.5–29.7 °C on Monday.
en.i4: Last night scored 91 on 7h 12m — fourteen above Tuesday’s 77 and nine minutes above the 7h 03m seven-night average. HRV recovered to 44 from Tuesday’s 39, two under the seven-night mean of 46 but two above the 28-day baseline of 42.0. RHR came back to 51, two below Tuesday’s 53 and level with the lowest nights on this board. Twelve minutes awake was the least of the seven. Readiness computes to 92.
en.rec: Tonnage over the last seven days is 22,908 kg across two lifting days, against 37,595 kg the week before, with the 28-day chronic load at 29,979 kg a week — an ACWR of 0.76. The flag is the hack squat top set: 170 kg × 12 on Aug 27 became 200 kg × 6 on Sep 3, a 17.6% load jump that has not been tested since, and the lift rotation puts hack next. Next session: hack squat, 4 × 8 at 170 kg. Carbohydrate is the lever: a hack day carries the 2,200 kcal training-day target with 212 g of carbohydrate, and the last three logged days landed 132–156 g. Put the missing ~60 g around the session.

hr.i1t: Četiri treninga, 22.908 kg u dva dana dizanja
hr.i1: Četiri treninga, 4h 44m, 22.908 kg, 2.639 aktivnih kcal — naspram pet treninga i 39.888 kg tjedan prije. Subotnji dan prednjeg čučnja najteži je komad: 81 minuta, 21 serija, 240 ponavljanja, 11.520 kg, prosj. HR 111, max 158, 604 aktivne kcal. Utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja trajao je 76 minuta, 18 serija, 246 ponavljanja, 11.388 kg, prosj. HR 123, max 155, 712 aktivnih kcal. Dva plivanja — 2.250 m u petak, 2.200 m u ponedjeljak — dodaju 1.323 kcal kroz 127 minuta.
hr.i2: Subotnji prednji čučanj zadržao je 80 kg i došao do 10 ponavljanja u vršnoj seriji, dva više od 8 na istom opterećenju 23.8. i 29.8. Tonaža treninga otišla je s 9.875 kg na 11.520 kg, više za 16,7% kroz 21 seriju i 240 ponavljanja. Prosj. HR 111 bio je najniži od četiri treninga na ovoj ploči, a max 158 najviši — težak vrh na inače jeftinom treningu.
hr.i3: Ponedjeljkovo plivanje u bazenu prešlo je 2.200 m u 64 minute kao 10×100 + 10×50, prosječno 2:18 na 100 m — dvije sekunde iza 2:16 od 31.8. na istoj seriji i izjednačeno s 2:18 od 26.8. Prosj. HR 121, max 148, 661 aktivna kcal, 27 zaveslaja u minuti kroz 88 dužina. Petkova serija N4×4 prešla je 2.250 m uz 2:26, osam sekundi na 100 m sporije uz viši prosj. HR 125. Zrak u Zagrebu bio je 16,5–29,7 °C u ponedjeljak.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 91 uz 7h 12m — četrnaest više od utorkovih 77 i devet minuta iznad sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 7h 03m. HRV se vratio na 44 s utorkovih 39, dva ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 46 ali dva iznad 28-dnevne osnove od 42,0. RHR se spustio na 51, dva ispod utorkovih 53 i izjednačen s najnižim noćima na ovoj ploči. Dvanaest minuta budnosti najmanje je od sedam. Spremnost se računa na 92.
hr.rec: Tonaža u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 22.908 kg kroz dva dana dizanja, naspram 37.595 kg tjedan prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 29.979 kg tjedno — ACWR 0,76. Zastavica: vršna serija hack čučnja otišla je sa 170 kg × 12 od 27.8. na 200 kg × 6 od 3.9., skok opterećenja od 17,6% koji od tada nije provjeren, a rotacija dizanja stavlja hack na red. Sljedeći trening: hack čučanj, 4 × 8 na 170 kg. Poluga su ugljikohidrati: dan hacka nosi cilj od 2.200 kcal za dan treninga uz 212 g ugljikohidrata, a zadnja tri zabilježena dana završila su na 132–156 g. Nedostajućih ~60 g stavi oko treninga.
